# gsm_game_server_cluster_policy (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "gsm_game_server_cluster_policy" "broserv_allocate" {
  cluster_name = "gsm-dev-gs-aks-krc"
  policy_name  = "broserv-allocate"

  subjects = ["urn:gsm::iam/user:<user_uuid>", "urn:gsm::iam/group:<group_uuid>"]
  objects  = ["urn:gsm::/cluster/gameserverclusters/gsm-dev-gs-aks-krc/**"]
  actions  = ["GameServerCluster_*"]
  effect   = "allow"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `actions` (List of String) List of actions permitted or denied by the policy
- `cluster_name` (String) Name of the game server cluster the policy belongs to
- `effect` (String) Policy effect: 'allow' or 'deny'
- `objects` (List of String) List of objects (resource URNs) governed by the policy
- `policy_name` (String) Name of the policy. Unique within the cluster scope.
- `subjects` (List of String) List of subjects (e.g. urn:gsm::iam/user:<email>) the policy applies to

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
